content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: MAJOR - canary-service-error-rate spike detected for release v1.12.3. Triggered at 2026-03-14T21:00:00Z. PD incident: PD-48723

pd-bot: Page sent to: alice-eng-oncall, ben-sre. Escalation policy: oncall -> sla-oncall -> eng-lead.

alice-eng-oncall: acked. I'm up — grabbing metrics and runbook. Can someone post quick summary of the canary rollout?

ben-sre: acked via PD. looking at grafana: canary group (canary-us-west-2) error rate jumped to ~18% 5xx in last 3m, baseline 0.5%. latency p50 also +40ms. traffic ~2% of global.

carlos-runtime: I kicked the v1.12.3 canary earlier in the window — included the new kv-cache rework + kernel selection tweak. No other infra changes.

alice-eng-oncall: ok, is the problem reproducible on traffic? any logs?

ben-sre: grabbing logs from the canary pods. tail:

```
2026-03-14T20:59:32Z canary-1 model-serving ERROR: Tokenization failed: InvalidTokenException: Token 0x3f encountered
2026-03-14T20:59:33Z canary-2 model-serving WARN: inference latency spike 1.2s
2026-03-14T20:59:34Z canary-1 model-serving ERROR: KVCache mismatch: expected 256 got 128
```

ben-sre: appears to be a mismatch inside client->runtime interaction (kv cache lengths). not OOM.

carlos-runtime: that matches the kv-cache change I rolled: default stride 256 -> 128 for compact quantized models. looks like the canary image built with mismatch header. investigating image diffs.

dana-product: flagged by a customer (enterprise-42) experiencing failed API calls. need a mitigation asap if impact >1 customer. what's the blast radius? canary only?

alice-eng-oncall: current traffic routed to canary only ~2% but the customer hit was from a weighted target (beta flag). I'd call this limited but customer-facing. recommend pause rollout and rollback to v1.12.2 if we can't confirm patch in 15m. thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben-sre: agree. initiating canary pause and rollback plan. Repro steps show tokenization errors occurring on quantized models only.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: Canary failure -> pause rollout -> rollback canary -> validate health. Checklist:
- [ ] run `/rollout pause --release v1.12.3 --target canary`
- [ ] run `/deploy rollback --release v1.12.2 --target canary`
- [ ] monitor error rate & latency for 10m
- [ ] notify customer support if >=1 customer impacted

alice-eng-oncall: running pause now:
```
/rollout pause --release v1.12.3 --target canary
```

alice-eng-oncall: pause confirmed by deploy-bot: rollout paused for v1.12.3 (canary). :white_check_mark:

carlos-runtime: I found the build pipeline produced two artifacts: `runtime-v1.12.3-q128` and `runtime-v1.12.3-q256`. Canary accidentally pulled q128 while manifest expected q256. root cause: image tag resolution race in CI. Fixing pipeline now.

ben-sre: starting rollback to v1.12.2 on canary:
```
/deploy rollback --release v1.12.2 --target canary --reason "kv-cache mismatch"
```

pd-bot: PD incident PD-48723 -> acknowledged by alice-eng-oncall and ben-sre. Escalations paused.

alice-eng-oncall: rollback job started, watching jobs. ETA ~3m.

incident-bot: Deploy job 349821 started for rollback. Logs streaming...

ben-sre: rollback logs show pods terminating and new pods with v1.12.2 coming up. healthcheck flapping for ~20s then passing.

carlos-runtime: validated runtime header lengths on new pods: kv-stride 256, matches manifest.

alice-eng-oncall: monitoring metrics: error rate dropping. p95 latency returning to baseline. will hold until 10m stable.

dana-product: I'll notify CS to contact enterprise-42 with a short note: we rolled canary back and are investigating root cause. keep me posted if they ask for timeline.

ben-sre: metrics at +8m after rollback: canary 5xx ~0.4% (baseline 0.5). marking PD incident for resolution pending postmortem.

alice-eng-oncall: closing PD-48723 in 5m if stable. assigning postmortem to carlos-runtime.

carlos-runtime: will open a postmortem PR and pipeline fix patch. preliminary mitigation: pin image tags in canary manifest and add CI gate verifying kv-cache header parity.

incident-bot: PD-48723 marked for resolution review. :white_check_mark:

alice-eng-oncall: thanks team. summary: canary image tag mismatch caused kv-cache/tokenization errors for quantized models. action items: pipeline fix, postmortem, customer notif (dana). moving to follow-up thread for postmortem drafts. :slightly_smiling_face:
